product_type: Rear combination lamp: an exterior lighting and signalling module combining rear position, stop and reversing lamps, outer lens and retro-reflector in a single housing
regulatory_scope: UNECE lighting regulations referenced apply across M and N categories.
mounting_location: Rear of the vehicle. The drawing's callout of reversing lamp visibility to 45° outboard suggests an outboard (corner) position; exact location and handedness are not stated.

functions.name: rear position lamp (presence/visibility signalling)
functions.description: Emits red light to the rear to show the vehicle's presence and width. Drawing callout gives a target of 4 to 17 cd on axis.

functions.name: stop lamp (braking indication)
functions.description: Emits red light to the rear to indicate service brake application. Drawing callout gives a target of 60 to 185 cd on axis.

functions.name: reversing lamp (reversing illumination)
functions.description: Illuminates the area behind the vehicle and warns others when reverse gear is engaged. Drawing callout requires visibility to 45° outboard.

functions.name: retro-reflector (passive conspicuity)
functions.description: Reflects incident light back towards its source so the vehicle is visible when unlit. Drawing callout gives a reflectivity requirement at 5° angle of incidence.

functions.name: light transmission and colour definition (outer lens)
functions.description: Outer lens transmits the emitted light and defines its colour. The red portion must fall within the chromaticity limits. It also closes and protects the optical assembly.

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.role: Transmits and colours the emitted light (red, within chromaticity limits) and forms the outer sealed cover of the lamp

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.role: Passive reflex reflecting element providing conspicuity

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.role: Perimeter seal between lens and housing that prevents water ingress (no ingress after spray test)

parts.name: Reflector
parts.role: Optical reflector with cup array and compartments that shapes and directs the LED light for the position, stop and reversing functions
parts.material: PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating, representative

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.role: Light source for the rear position, stop and reversing functions
parts.material: LED modules on printed circuit board

parts.name: Housing
parts.role: Main body carrying the PCB, reflector, seal and lens; provides mounting bosses for attachment to the vehicle

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.role: Secure the lamp to the vehicle body and keep it aimed under vibration

parts.name: Rear position lamp (function unit)
parts.role: Lighting function realised by LEDs and reflector sections

parts.name: Stop lamp (function unit)
parts.role: Lighting function realised by LEDs and reflector sections

parts.name: Reversing lamp (function unit)
parts.role: Lighting function realised by LED(s) and a dedicated reflector compartment

electronics: LED modules mounted on a PCB serving as the light source for the rear position, stop and reversing functions
Array of about 28 small LED packages shown on the PCB
Larger square component on the PCB (possibly the reversing lamp LED)
Multi-pin connector-like component on the PCB for electrical connection to the vehicle harness
vehicle_interfaces: Mechanically attached to the rear vehicle body by three fasteners/clips through bosses on the housing
Electrical connection to the vehicle harness via the PCB connector
Switched by the vehicle lighting circuit (position), brake system signal (stop) and reverse gear signal (reversing)
Sealed against body and environment by the gasket and lens/housing joint
drawing_observations: The outer lens has a distinct rectangular window area in its upper outboard region, likely a separate optical zone for the reversing lamp or the retro-reflector
The retro-reflector is drawn as a separate small rectangular prism element between the outer lens and the seal
The reflector carries an array of about 30 reflector cups plus two rectangular compartments, one tall and plain, one with a grid pattern
The PCB shows a grid of small LEDs, a larger square component and a striped, connector-like component
The housing has three to four bosses/holes for fasteners, and three pin/screw fasteners are shown
The seal is a continuous perimeter gasket following the lens outline

Callouts state performance targets: position lamp 4–17 cd on axis, stop lamp 60–185 cd on axis, reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard, retro-reflectivity at 5° incidence, no water ingress after spray test, aim retained under vibration
uncertainties: Specification materials are described as representative values to be confirmed against the actual bill of materials

Whether the position and stop functions share the same LEDs at different intensities or use separate LEDs
Identity of the larger square component and the striped component on the PCB (reversing LED and connector assumed)
Whether LED driver or control electronics are on the PCB
Exact mounting position on the vehicle (outboard corner inferred) and whether left and right variants exist
Number and type of fasteners (screws vs clips) and whether the retro-reflector is a separate part or integrated into the lens
